newsitem.title: UK: House of Fraser finance director resigns.
newsitem.headline: House of Fraser finance director resigns.

text.p: House of Fraser Plc said on Wednesday that its finance director, Richard Scott, has left the British department store chain "by mutual agreement", to pursue private interests.
It said it will announce a replacement for Scott in due course.
A company spokesman said the group would appoint headhunters to find a replacement for Scott, who will leave in the next few days. The spokesman said his departure was "non-contentious."
Scott has been with the department store for about 20 years and has been finance director since the company's flotation in April 1994.
Loss-making House of Fraser is in the middle of a major restructuring to cut costs and revive sales by revamping its clothing ranges.
Its shares were barely changed at 0835 GMT, up 0.5 pence to 153.5. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
